text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: (I can win! I will win! Keep runnin'. Don't give up. Just keep goin'! Go, go, go, go!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Let your tenacity carry you through!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Let your tenacity carry you through!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...!
Get outta my heaaad!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur did it! She's this year's Derby

champion!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Shakur! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(My number is first on the scoreboard.
People are
shoutin' my name...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That means... I actually won.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...It shouldn't be possible.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But it changed. I turned the
seven-centimeter gap
around...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I really...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I really... changed my fate.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You gotta be kiddin' me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur falls to her knees as if
suddenly deflated, and the energy of
the crowd shifts at
the sight of her
uncharacteristic behavior.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I made it.
...My tenacity carried me
through.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You look so stupid right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're grinning like a damn fool.

Dummy.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Why not? I just won.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's right, I won. The Derby has beat
me down
hundreds of times now!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And yet I still won! Isn't that worth
laughing
about?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely not dreaming. Everyone at
this
racecourse is my witness.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Is this freakin' wild or what?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But I guess this is no time to be
laughin'.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I need to give Parcae the results.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Depending on what it says, this victory
could still
very well be meaningless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She once told me that the most
important thing is whether or not
winning the Derby can help
change her
fate.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All right, it's the moment of truth. Give
me some
good news...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur has been fiddling with her
laptop ever since we returned to the
academy. After a few
more clicks and
taps...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The hell?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Parcae... They're givin' me an error.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
No, all the other functions are workin'
fine... Hang
on, lemme run a systems
check.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I dunno what the problem is, but they
keep givin' me an error when I try to
calculate the chances of
winning my next
race.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've lost the ability to see how I'll
do in
all of my
future races.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Good question.
choice_data_list: Does that mean... fate has changed?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The fact stands that the
seven-centimeter
calculation changed. It
might be time to
acknowledge that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It's not hell that awaits me now, but the
great
unknown.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Don't get ahead of yourself. Just 'cause I
can't
calculate the results, it doesn't
mean my terrible
fate has changed.
choice_data_list: Which means the Senior Year is...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Anyway, we can talk about that later.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
For all we know, this change could mean
even my
predicted win in the Kikuka Sho
might end in
humiliation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
By Parcae's original prediction, Air
Shakur was set to win the Satsuki Sho
and Kikuka Sho, making
her a Twin
Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But if losing big is a possibility...
It's also
possible
that things're gonna start
lookin' up for me...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? I could lap everyone. Not
that
there's any evidence of that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I almost can't believe it, but for the first time ever, Air Shakur actually looks excited about her future.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and summer camp's right around the
corner.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I already had a training regimen in mind,
but I
think I'll have Parcae readjust it for
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
All the other functions work just fine. I
can still make use of Parcae's calculation
and analysis
features. I'm in no rush to
trash them just yet.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm also on my way to meeting all the
conditions
required to win the Kikuka
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And if I surpass those target values at
summer camp, then I might be able to
achieve even better
results than
expected.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...It's all a moot point, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
So long as I don't know what's causin'
the error,
there's no way of fixin' it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(And there's still one big question. What
did that 991031021222 number mean?
Why did it
appear, and why'd it
disappear all of a sudden?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Parcae... Are you trying to tell me
something?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ridiculous. Like they could do that.
